Zoe (CS): Heads-up: VendorCarve submitted a SIG + bespoke CAIQ. They want KMS/HSM attestation, audit-log samples, and a reproducible export flow. They also report intermittent 401s hitting /sig-export when pulling KMS-backed keys. Customer asked for responses by EOD Wed. Adding @Arjun S., @Ben I., @Sam (Support), @Nina (Legal).

Sam (Support): Assigned. Can you paste the 401 response body + sample request id?

Zoe (CS): pasted the snippet below — customer redacted token:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sig-export?org=vendorcarve"
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{
  "error": "unauthorized",
  "message": "token invalid",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d"
}
```

Ben I.: Thx. Quick hypothesis: token rejected by auth when KMS key rotation in progress. Need full request headers and exact timestamp. Can you ask them to capture X-Request-Received and Authorization timestamps?

Arjun S. (Security): For SIG: we'll need HSM attestation doc + KMS key metadata (creation/rotation timestamps, key-id, provider). Also need audit-log sample showing export events and principal IDs (redact PII). Default retention is 90d; customer asking for 7y retention? confirm.

Zoe (CS): They want 7y for compliance. They're on Dedicated. I told them default is 90d but can map to long-term via log-archival to their S3. Customer asked for proof-of-export (signed by HSM) — is that possible?

Arjun S. (Security): We can provide HSM attestation from vendor (YubiHSM/Thales) for Private/Dedicated with an extra addendum. For hosted, attestation limited. I'll pull template. Ben - can you try to repro 401 with a short script? Include token lifetime check.

Ben I.: Repro steps:
1) Grab a valid token
2) Wait > token TTL (or set expiry)
3) Call:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Trace: true" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sig-export?org=vendorcarve"
```
If you see `request_id` req_* and 401, attach full headers. Also check our internal auth service logs via `auth-service: /logs?request_id=req_x`.

Sam (Support): I asked customer for full headers + timestamped logs. They provided request_id req_0a1b2c3d and a cropped header set — looks like token TTL mismatch. Sending to infra for confirmation.

AuditBot: Ticket created: CS-7234 — Security questionnaire follow-up; linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7234

Nina (Legal): We can request +5 business days extension for the SIG responses; approved if CS documents interim mitigation and timeline. Zoe please confirm.

Zoe (CS): Confirmed. I'll tell customer we have +5 business days and will deliver HSM attestation + audit-log sample + repro playbook. Also offering a temporary export run from our side to produce signed proof; need infra support.

Ben I.: I'll run a controlled export with support token and attach signed export proof. Will redact key material. ETA: ~48h.

Arjun S. (Security): I'll prepare attestation template and checklist for SIG answers (KMS key IDs, rotation cadence, audit log schema). Sharing in #eng-security.

Zoe (CS): Thanks — I'll update the customer and close this loop once we have outputs.
